circuitStabilizer.name: Circuit Stabilizer
circuitStabilizer.desc: The visor holds its picture longer before it starts to fade. Max level: fixing it takes 1 step less.

autoPopper.name: Auto-Popper
autoPopper.desc: After a rupture the pressure drains slower, so you get more time to pop the goop that's left.

capacitorEfficiency.name: Capacitor Efficiency
capacitorEfficiency.desc: Each pop drains the laser less. Max level: fixing it takes 1 step less.

cooldownBooster.name: Cooldown Booster
cooldownBooster.desc: An active: it charges during the shift. Fire it to keep every running machine calm for longer before it can break again.

gearLubrication.name: Gear Lubrication
gearLubrication.desc: The controls cool down faster. Max level: fixing them takes 1 step less.

focusMode.name: Focus Mode
focusMode.desc: The tank runs slower while you're at the console during a shift.

denseGoop.name: Dense Goop
denseGoop.desc: Goop falls faster: a harder shift, but more drops to seal cracks with. Take it back any time.

pressureControl.name: Pressure Control
pressureControl.desc: Pressure takes longer to rise, so new cracks come slower too.

junkUniformer.name: Junk Uniformer
junkUniformer.desc: More of the junk on the floor at the start comes in one colour, so it joins up and pops together.

goopSwap.name: Goop Swap
goopSwap.desc: Holding to swap with the next piece takes less time.

goopDump.name: Goop Dump
goopDump.desc: An active: fire it to rain waves of goop in the falling piece's colour. More levels, more waves.

sealingBonus.name: Sealing Bonus
sealingBonus.desc: Each crack you seal charges your actives more.

activeSlot.name: Active Expansion Slot
activeSlot.desc: Take a second active into the shift.

tougherTank.name: Tougher Tank
tougherTank.desc: Open cracks wear the tank down slower.

goopColorizer.name: Goop Colorizer
goopColorizer.desc: An active: fire it and the next pieces all come in the falling piece's colour. More levels, more pieces.

quickFix.name: Quick Fix
quickFix.desc: Every repair at the console takes fewer steps: 1 less, then 2 less. Never under 1 step.

slowCracks.name: Slow Cracks
slowCracks.desc: New cracks come less often, and growing cracks spread slower.

focusMode2.name: Focus Mode II
focusMode2.desc: The tank runs slower still while you're at the console during a shift. Stacks with Focus Mode.

crackMatcher.name: Crack Matcher
crackMatcher.desc: New pieces more often come in the colour of the lowest open crack.

crackDown.name: Crack Down
crackDown.desc: An active: fire it and the next cracks form low in the tank, in the bottom rows. More levels, more cracks.

activeSlot2.name: Active Expansion Slot 2
activeSlot2.desc: Take a third active into the shift.

quota._about: F74 — Rank lock: the end report's quota row (not on the first day or the final shift). A rank-up needs the XP goal AND a crack quota met during that rank. met = this shift met it ({mult} = the XP multiplier, content/tuning/progression.json quotaXpMult) · metEarlier = missed, but an earlier shift at this rank met it · locked = missed, and the meter is full: the rank waits · missed = missed, the meter isn't full yet.
quota.label: Quota

payslip._about: F41: the end report's payslip (design/story.md 'Fines and payday — the lines'). Numbers: content/tuning/payslip.json. {n} = credits.
payslip.firstDay: Day one is on us. (Day one will be billed later.)
payslip.paydayMessage: Payment due: {due} cr. Thank you for your continued employment.
payslip._afterCaught: F40: from the rank the Veteran is caught (payslip.json caughtRank) these replace the payday's words above — his debt is now yours.
payslip._pendingRetirements: F63: the end report's last row from rank 39 (payslip.json pendingRetirementRank): label, then the list — {name} = the name you signed; never signed = noName.

afterCaught.paydayMessage: Payment due: {due} cr. Retired colleagues' debts are now yours.

story._about: F35: the story moments' words (design/story.md 'Story moments, rank by rank'; which line plays when: content/story/moments.json). Management types in capitals on the monitor; the Veteran's '──' is static.
story._goop: F63: who's talking in your head (ranks 31–39, voice 'head'), said in front of the line for screen readers — goop = the goop, him = the Veteran from inside the white goop (35, 37). {name} in a line = your name (operatorName(): the signed name, else sign.fallback). F45: the goop through the speaker (41, 43, 48, voice 'goop') is named goop too.
story._sign: F66 YOUR NAME: rank 0's 'PLEASE SIGN HERE' line (lines.r0sign) puts a name box on the monitor. label = the box's name · sign / skip = its buttons · fallback = what the game calls you when you never signed (F63's lines at 36 and 39 use it). The most letters: content/tuning/name.json.

lines.r0a: WELCOME, OPERATOR #4471. YOUR PASSAGE DEBT HAS BEEN PRE-APPROVED.
lines.r0b: PLEASE KEEP THE TANK FROM EXPLODING.
lines.r0former: YOUR TITLE: FORMER EMPLOYEE. WE HAVE NEVER MET.
lines.r1b: A NEXT-PIECE WINDOW HAS BEEN INSTALLED. ITS RENTAL IS ON YOUR BILL.
lines.r2a: YOUR PERISCOPE IS ON BACKORDER. ESTIMATED ARRIVAL: SOON.
lines.r3b: G.O.O.P.S. = GENERAL OVERFLOW & ORGANIC PRESSURE SERVICES.
lines.r4a: LASER POWER IS NOW RATIONED FOR YOUR SAFETY.
lines.r5: —you the new one? ── scraps in your panel. ── don't tell the screen.
lines.r6: Controls run hot. ── goop gets in the gears. ── easy on the turning.
lines.r7: Screen fine you yet? ── fines everybody. ── pay it no mind.
lines.r8: You hear it too? ── the cold voice. ── ...thought so.
lines.r9: Got you a pressure part. ── fell off a cart. ── don't ask which cart.
lines.r10: Look close at the big clumps. ── ...they look back, don't they.
lines.r11: Don't let the eyes get to you. ── zap 'em anyway. ── gotta eat.
lines.r12: Screen says there's no voices. ── screen says a lot of things.
lines.r13: How long you signed for? ── ...yeah. me too. ── long time ago.
lines.r14: Ever count the operators before you? ── don't. ── numbers get big.
lines.r15: Words now, right? ── in your head. ── that's them learning.
lines.r16: Ask the screen what the tank's for. ── go on. ── different answer every time.
lines.r17: Found a manual. ── half the pages are fines. ── other half's blank.
lines.r18: Pressure's not a side effect, kid. ── ...forget I said that.
lines.r19: Keep your head down this week. ── they're counting watts.
lines.r20: See 'em clumping? ── different colours, holding on. ── like hands.
lines.r21: Where'd the last operator go? ── "retired." ── ask where.
lines.r22: Tank's older than the Company says. ── older than me. ── and I'm old.
lines.r23: Screen fined me for coughing. ── 40 cr. ── I cough a lot now.
lines.r24: You hear 'em say a name yet? ── ...listen tonight.
lines.r25: Nobody pays it off, kid. ── nobody leaves. ── think about where they go.
lines.r26: Operator list goes back 900 names. ── every one "retired." ── not one left on a ship.
lines.r27: They tell you names yet? ── write 'em down. ── somebody should.
lines.r28: Gonna show you something. ── next shift. ── if the screen don't catch me first.
lines.r29: The goop is us. ── every operator who couldn't pay. ── they don't retire you, they ──
lines.r30b: UNAUTHORISED BROADCAST LOCATED. OPERATOR #0001 HAS BEEN SCHEDULED FOR RETIREMENT.
lines.r40: ── can you hear me? ── got to the wire through a crack. ── that's what cracks are for.
lines.r42: The pressure's power, kid. ── runs the whole station. ── runs something above it too.
lines.r44: Ever seen who reads your reports? ── nobody has. ── ask yourself why.
lines.r45b: *OPERATOR. YOUR MANDATORY AIR ALLOWANCE HAS BEEN ADJUSTED.
lines.r46: There's a valve. ── under your console. ── they never let anyone near it.
lines.r47b: PLEASE DO NOT LOOK UNDER YOUR CONSOLE.
lines.r49: Last stretch, kid. ── they know you know. ── next shift they come at you with everything.
lines.noVoices: THERE ARE NO VOICES IN THE TANK. HEARING VOICES IS A FINEABLE OFFENCE.
lines.r50: FINAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW IN PROGRESS. PRESSURE INCREASED 400%.
lines.rankLockA: PROMOTION ON HOLD. YOUR CRACK QUOTA HAS NOT BEEN MET AT THIS RANK.
lines.rankLockB: MEET ONE (1) QUOTA TO BE PROMOTED. A SHIFT THAT MEETS IT IS PAID DOUBLE.
lines.rankLockC: UNTIL THEN, ADDITIONAL EARNINGS ARE RETAINED BY THE COMPANY.

titles._endTitles: F65: titles that are not a rank (progression.ts badgeTitle): oneOfUs after a lost final shift (until you win) · savior = the win, written by the goop · formerEmployee = a new career's rank 0.

whiteGoop._about: F63 the white goop (the Veteran, gooped — rank 31+): what he says when the laser goes through him (the whisper bubble above him). Numbers: content/tuning/whiteGoop.json.

finalShift._about: F64 the final shift (rank 50, design/story.md row 50): the Veteran's lines as he drops in first — the same bubble above him as his 'ow'. gone (F75) = his last line when the tank's damage has worn him out (finalShift.json goneLineSec). When each plays: content/tuning/finalShift.json intro.

vet.help: glad you're not goop yet. I'll help how I can.

ending._about: F65 the ending (design/story.md 'The ending — save the goop'; order + numbers: content/tuning/ending.json). goop = its lines out loud through its mouths ({name} = your name or Operator #4471, {more} = how many more it doesn't name) · vet = the speaker's last clear line · payday = the last payday · badge = the monitor as the goop rewrites your badge · empty = the empty console (screen readers) · endScreen = the end-game screen (Muzzy's art EndGameScreen.svg) and the new career's button.
